articles.summary: NextNav recently filed reply comments with the Federal Communications Commission in support of our petition to reconfigure the Lower 900 MHz Band to enable a 5G-based terrestrial positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) service that can be readily deployed and adopted to serve as a complement and backup to GPS and support 5G broadband deployment and use.
articles.title: NextNav’s Latest Filing in Support of 3D Terrestrial PNT Solution for a Complement and Backup to GPS
